stories.headline: Merck KGaA's $73.00/share (~$11.5B) acquisition of Bio-Techne goes to a definitive proxy; Goldman advises Bio-Techne, Guggenheim and JPMorgan advise Merck
stories.why_it_matters: Bio-Techne (Nasdaq: TECH), a life-sciences tools and reagents maker, filed its definitive merger proxy (DEFM14A) on Aug 20 for its acquisition by Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany at $73.00 per share in cash (a roughly $11.5B transaction). The special meeting is set for Sept 23, 2026 (virtual). Per the proxy, Goldman Sachs is Bio-Techne's financial adviser (sell-side), while Guggenheim Securities and J.P. Morgan are Merck KGaA's financial advisers (buy-side). A large cross-border strategic acquisition runs multi-jurisdiction antitrust, proxy-solicitation and shareholder-vote workstreams into the Sept 23 vote.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Goldman (Bio-Techne) and Guggenheim/JPMorgan (Merck KGaA) — a ~$11.5B cross-border life-sciences acquisition heading to a Sept 23 vote runs antitrust and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

stories.headline: Huntsman/Olin all-stock merger votes are 4 days out (Aug 25); Citi and Morgan Stanley advise Huntsman, Lazard advises Olin
stories.why_it_matters: Olin (NYSE: OLN) and Huntsman (NYSE: HUN) hold special meetings Aug 25, 2026 to vote on their all-stock merger (agreement dated Jun 15), after a supplemental proxy disclosure resolved shareholder litigation. Citi and Morgan Stanley advise Huntsman; Lazard advises Olin. With the vote days away, the chemicals combination is in its final proxy-solicitation and closing stretch.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Citi/Morgan Stanley (Huntsman) and Lazard (Olin) now — with the vote 4 days out, a chemicals merger runs its final proxy-solicitation and closing diligence a secure room keeps organized.

deal_clock.event: Huntsman and Olin special meetings (shareholder votes) — in 4 days

stories.headline: Werewolf Therapeutics launches a reverse merger with Ambros Therapeutics plus a concurrent PIPE; Piper Sandler advises Werewolf
stories.why_it_matters: Werewolf Therapeutics (Nasdaq: HOWL) agreed (Aug 21) to a reverse merger with privately held Ambros Therapeutics in which pre-merger Ambros stockholders are expected to own ~71.7% of the combined company, PIPE investors ~21.5% and existing Werewolf holders ~6.8%, alongside a concurrent PIPE financing. Piper Sandler & Co. is financial adviser to Werewolf (it delivered the fairness opinion to the Werewolf Board) and — with Leerink, Cantor, Wells Fargo Securities and LifeSci Capital — a placement agent for the PIPE. A reverse merger with a concurrent PIPE runs registration, PIPE and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Piper Sandler (Werewolf) and Wells Fargo (PIPE placement) — a biopharma reverse merger with a concurrent PIPE runs registration, financing and proxy diligence a secure room organizes to close.

deal_clock.event: Werewolf/Ambros reverse merger + concurrent PIPE announced

stories.headline: Zymeworks' $17.00/share-plus-CVR acquisition of Theravance Biopharma goes to a definitive proxy; Lazard advises Theravance
stories.why_it_matters: Theravance Biopharma (Nasdaq: TBPH) filed its definitive proxy (DEFM14A) on Aug 21 for its acquisition by Zymeworks (Nasdaq: ZYME) at $17.00 per ordinary share in cash plus one contingent value right (CVR) per share (merger agreement dated Jun 28), with an Extraordinary General Meeting set for September. Lazard (Lazard Freres & Co.) is Theravance's financial adviser and fairness-opinion provider. A cash-plus-CVR acquisition of a Cayman-domiciled biopharma runs CVR-structuring, scheme/merger and shareholder-vote workstreams.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Lazard (Theravance) — a $17.00/share-plus-CVR biopharma acquisition at its definitive-proxy stage runs CVR-structuring and shareholder-vote diligence a secure room organizes to close.

stories.headline: JBS's proposal to buy in the ~18% Pilgrim's Pride minority stays live; Citi advises JBS
stories.why_it_matters: JBS N.V. (NYSE: JBS), which owns ~82% of Pilgrim's Pride (NASDAQ: PPC), has a non-binding proposal (Aug 18) to acquire the PPC shares it doesn't own at a fixed 2.086 JBS Class A shares per PPC share (implied ~$28.50/PPC share). Citi is JBS's financial adviser. The take-in is conditioned on a to-be-appointed special committee of independent PPC directors (own advisers to come) and a majority-of-minority vote.
stories.suggested_action: Engage Citi (JBS) and watch for PPC's special committee to name its own independent adviser — a second, sell-side mandate on the same deal.

PPC special committee to be appointed and retain independent advisers
